caption: The drawing consists of a single, monochromatic figure rendered in shades of gray pencil, centered on a plain, light-colored background with a thin rectangular border. The object depicted is a humanoid figure with a rounded, helmet-like head and a simple facial structure including eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The figure wears a short, wide garment that flares out at the bottom, resembling a tunic or armor. Both arms extend outward and downward, each ending not in hands but in wide, flat, blade-like shapes, suggesting possible weapons or tools. The legs are straight and cylindrical, with slight indications of joints at the knees and what appear to be boots or feet at the ends. The figure appears mechanical or jointed, as indicated by clear separations at the shoulders, hips, and knees. The overall composition is vertically oriented, and the drawing is done with careful shading to indicate texture and dimension.
title: Whirligig
